answer: Each ivory is a clone. violet is the sole flow ledger binding key, endpoint and route, so twins merge. Weight is max-flow from fixed roots; edges have unit capacity, violet allows one augmentation per epoch, and the kth edge-disjoint path into a cluster burns k opal from both endpoints. n heavy ivory need n disjoint root paths, about n(n+1)/2 opal over n epochs, not splittable. It fails if violet admits parallel edges, roots sell flow, or opal transfers.
